experiment: Frozen multi-session verifier repair retry A/B
retrieval_source: Stage243 per-question retrieval files; both arms reused the saved retrieval ranking without reranking

shared_settings.reranker: disabled in both arms; Stage243 retrieval order reused

control.transient_retries: One structured-call timeout and one structured-output parse retry recovered; all rows completed

other.interpretation: The two candidate-only wins had no verifier repair attempt; this subgroup difference cannot be attributed to the feature.

discarded_interrupted_attempt: An initial control attempt stopped at 16/133 because the temporary disk filled. Its outputs were discarded; both scorecard arms were restarted from compact copies of the unchanged Stage243 retrieval rows and completed fully.
decision: Reject the retry feature. It produced no net accuracy gain, had two more invalid answer audits, and lost two net answers in the numeric-aggregate subset. The two apparent non-numeric wins had no repair attempts and are run variance, not feature evidence. The uncommitted adapter implementation was discarded; no feature flag remains.
limitations: One provider A/B run per arm; accepted seeds do not force identical generation (exact final answer text matched in only 27/133). This is a pilot, not a new full 500-question score or release gate.
